A.label: series:IV:A
A.literature_tex: The characteristic classification and native generators are the known results of \cite[Proposition~3.1, Lemmas~4.4 and~4.8, Theorem~4.9, and Lemma~6.2]{Jin2026}. The source uses the seam $(x,0)\sim(f(x),1)$, its preferred clutch generator has $\langle p_1,[S^4]\rangle=4$, and its pairs are $(1,4)$ and $(8,8)$. The exact line-duality, Hopf-normal and inverse-endpoint maps in \cref{night:P3K.68} transport those data to the physical $M$ and the forward seam here. The resulting source-page formula and the corrections to \cref{night:P3K.30} are stated with that fixed transport.

B.label: series:IV:B
B.literature_tex: The elliptic-surface input is \cite[Main Theorem, pp.~85--86]{OguisoShioda1991}, with the height and base-change laws of \cite[Theorem~8.6 and Proposition~8.12, pp.~228--231]{Shioda1990}. The actual quotient, Mumford filling and logarithmic modifications instantiate \cite[Section~2 and Remark~8.5]{Engel2026}; the specified surface, point line and translation are the input maps. The page and physical-clutch calculations give the displayed source-specific integers, including the weighted $M_7,-2G$ class four. The corrected fixed-edge rule uses the retained common-link map and native right integer $6A_M$, hence $A_M+6A_M=7A_M$. The precise historical claims are \cref{night:P3K.10,night:P3K.22,night:P3K.23,night:P3F.53}.

C.label: series:IV:C
C.literature_tex: Periodic simplicial fillings are already provided by \cite[Proposition~2.8]{Engel2026}. For the original reference fan, the fixed curve, its weights and finite-subgroup fixed sets are \cite[Proposition~9.24 and Remarks~9.25--9.26, pp.~82--83]{AC26}; the basis adapter and quotient-lattice map are retained in \cref{night:P3F.35}. Here the complete parameter endpoint and each target prism determine the physical return on the ordered fan. The explicit pairs of actual returns in \cref{iv:correction:P3K.31,iv:correction:P3K.33} locate the failed norm-polynomial assertions and identify their replacement.

D.label: series:IV:D
D.literature_tex: The elliptic quotient and logarithmic-cap construction is \cite[Section~2 and Remark~8.5]{Engel2026}. At $r=0$, the literal source map is $\tau=4/(27t+4)$, $X=(9/2)\tau^2x$, $Y=27\tau^3y/(2\sqrt2)$; it preserves the marked point and extends by the displayed minimal-coordinate unit maps. For each point line, multiplication by its full Miller function gives $M_1^{\otimes a}\to M_a$, and the chronological identity $\mathcal F_a\mathcal B_1=\mathcal B_a^a\mathcal F_a$ relates the regular quotients. The present source-loop assertions include their additional original-height, root, fan and endpoint maps, and retain the exact parameter degrees when evaluating returns.

E.label: series:IV:E
E.literature_tex: The elliptic/toroidal construction is credited to \cite[Section~2 and Remark~8.5]{Engel2026}, and the physical characteristic classification to \cite[Theorem~4.9 and Lemma~6.2]{Jin2026}, through the explicit transports of \cref{night:P3K.68}. The additional conclusions here are the marked-source pairs $(-27,-12)$ and $(-3,-12)$, the full cap products preserving both integers, and the two ordered-fan formulas with their exact sixteen-element image. The comparison with AC26, E26 and both DGKX versions is recorded at these precise marked-return claims.

F.literature_tex: The construction and bordism inputs are \cite[Section~2 and Remark~8.5]{Engel2026} and \cite[Theorem~4.9 and Lemma~6.2]{Jin2026}. The source comparison retains those maps and parameter degrees.
